Follow a request
  1. 1Ask for access. The requester names the secret, the keys and why. No value is sent.
  2. 2Someone approves. The policy for the project and environment decides how many approvals it needs and from whom.
  3. 3The agent claims the job. The agent calls out to the control plane for work. Nothing calls in, so you open no inbound port.
  4. 4It reads the provider. The agent reads only the approved keys, with its own credentials, inside your infrastructure.
  5. 5It sends back a sealed wrap. The values travel back encrypted for this request and are held only as a single-use wrap with a short lifetime.
  6. 6Reveal once. The requester confirms with a second factor and sees each value once. Every step is in the audit log.
